characteristics.name: Keywords
characteristics.$text: Deadly 2, Huge, Fly, Immune, Pierce 1, Reach

rules.name: Blade Cyclone
rules.description:
Each Character Raphael Threatens takes X Dice of Damage (X= Raphael's Attack +1) Reduce each Character's Armor value by Raphael's Pierce value while resolving this ability. 

FAQ: For those using this ability you will not use Deadly with this as it is an Active Ability. It does not have the Attack text in front of it so it does not use Keywords other than those mentioned in the actions text.

rules.name: Brilliant Radiance
rules.description: Characters threatened by Raphael lose -1 Accuracy or -2 while attacking her.

rules.name: Holy Rage
rules.description:
While Bloodied, Raphael gets +1 Attack, +1 Speed and Advantage while Attacking

FAQ: This ability can combine with Blade Cyclone (BC). If this is activated before BC you will use the +1 of this ability as well as +1 of BC

rules.name: Hyperkinetic Perforation
rules.description:
Attack. Veronique gains Advantage for this attack. ignore all tokens, keywords, abilities on enemy characters for this attack. Your opponent cannot play Fate. 

FAQ: Since this Ability has the Attack in front you will use all your keywords as if this were a regular attack. This attack is the only way to bypass the Immune Keyword on many opponents. If a status is applied to a character with immune due to this attack it will resolve once then

rules.name: Telekinetic Shield
rules.description: When a friendly character within 3 and sight is attacked, the attacker gains Disadvantage. After the attack resolves, Daze the attacker

rules.name: Unlimited Power
rules.description:
Channel


Note: This is a great way to get one free fate each time you activate this character. Remember Swifts can be used once per round and only when the character has been activated.

rules.name: Brilliant Charge
rules.description: When Rodrigo declares an attack after Charging, he gains +1 Attack for every 2 spaces moved this activation.

rules.name: Peerless Champion
rules.description:
While attacking or defending, Rodrigo may increase or decrease the result on any die by 1 (before resolving re-rolls or critical effects.)

Note: Doing this can assist you when trying to get rolls of 5 or defending against rolls of 5. This is in addition to any Advantage or Disadvantage in the attack.

rules.name: Stampede
rules.description:
Move. Rodrigo does not provoke Attack of Opportunity during this activation and he can move through smaller characters. When you move through a smaller character, that character takes 1 damage. 

Note: This is for any model with a small base (Heroes included). Huge enemies can not be affected by this and will stop any movement.

rules.name: Blessed by the Heavens
rules.description:
When Sephiria is attacked, the attacking character cannot use keywords during this attack. 

This attack can help against armies with many Deadly keywords. As it is a reaction it can be activated as many times as you have Fate to spare.

rules.name: Divine Decree
rules.description: Command an Angel or Holy character, regardless of Rank. you may spend {2} to assign that character a Shield Token.

rules.name: Radiant Strike
rules.description: After Sephiria's attack resolves, Daze the defender

rules.name: Lioness' Roar
rules.description: Boost All herself. Break Attack all enemy characters of lower rank within 3. (Troops)

rules.name: Unstoppable
rules.description: Elladarieth ignores all effects which reduce or prevent her movement and cannot be moved by opposing effects.

rules.name: Savage Pounce
rules.description: Melee Attack. If Elladarieth has charged this turn, -1 Attack and Deadly 2 for this attack.

rules.name: Born Leader
rules.description: Command. The commanded character may then perform any action.

rules.name: Follow My Example
rules.description: While another friendly character is melee attacking a character Godfrey threatens, that character gains Accuracy 1 (Accuracy 2 if friendly unit is adjacent to Godfrey)

rules.name: Great Cleave
rules.description: After Godfrey's attack resolves, choose a character adjacent to the defender that you threaten. Attack that character. Godfrey gains disadvantage during this attack.

rules.name: Duelist
rules.description: While Elya is threatened by only a single enemy she gains Accuracy 4 and Evasive 4

rules.name: Commander of the Rose
rules.description:
Command a Rose character, regardless of Rank. you may spend {2} to Command each adjacent Rose character regardless of Rank. 

Note: This Swift is a great way to make a Power move against your enemy. If you are in a pinch use this to get an instantaneous activation of a near by character without having to wait for their turn. (Still counts as that Characters activation) This does not activate whole units. Only 1 troop in that unit.

rules.name: Swirling Riposte
rules.description:
After an attack against Elya resolves Sidestep. Attack the enemy that just attacked Elya. 

Note: This does not count as an activation as it is a reaction. This can activate each time a unit attacks Elya. Not just once per round.

rules.name: Consecrated Ward
rules.description:
Henril cannot be chose as part of enemy card effects or abilities.

Note: This makes him a great foe to Vahlrose and any Lillin characters.

rules.name: Break the Seal
rules.description: When Henril's Health is Equal or less than 2 then Recover 2, Attack +3. cannot use ranged weapons, Defense +1, Speed +1 place a Wound Token on himself Cannot use the trait Human for the rest of the game.

rules.name: Blessed Bolt
rules.description:
Attack. After this attack resolves, if the defender too any damage as part of this attack, Daze them and deal 3 Dice of Direct Damage to them. 

Note: With this attack you ignore enemy armor in the Defend total calculations. (Only with the Dice of Direct Damage)

rules.name: Fear the Fearless
rules.description: When Bertrogard attacks or is attacked, Break Any on the Opposing character.

rules.name: Silence of the Fates
rules.description: While Bertrogard is attacking or defending your opponent cannot play Fate cards.

rules.name: Relentless
rules.description:
Betrogard cannot fall except at the end of the Activation Phase. he cannot be felled due to enemy effects or abilities. 

Note: If an enemy effect were to kill him he would instead fall at the end of the Activation phase instead of immediately.

rules.name: Expose Weakness
rules.description:
When Charlotte attacks, choose one:
Pierce 2 for this attack or -1 Defence

rules.name: When They Can't Strike Back
rules.description:
While Charlotte is attacking an activated character, she gains Accuracy 2 and Advantage

Note: This means any character that has already been activated this phase.

rules.name: Shadowstep
rules.description: Place Charlotte into an empty space within 2. (Great to cover distance before moving or attacking as it is a Swift)

rules.name: Bright Blessing
rules.description:
Recover 4 a character within 2 and sight. Discard all Banes from that character. 

Note: This can not be applied to herself

rules.name: Chosen One
rules.description: When Yakun activates, if you have fewer Fate in your pool than your opponent, shift one Fate to your pool.

rules.name: Inspiration
rules.description: Command, ignoring Rank

rules.name: Protect the King
rules.description: After a friendly adjacent character is attacked, move a Shield token from yourself to the defending character.

rules.description: Attack 3. You lose Pierce 2 for this attack. If this attack deals at least 1 damage, Daze the defender.

rules.name: Avenger
rules.description:
When a friendly Hero or Rose character Falls, Focus or Attack. 

Note: This is a better version of a basic Rose Knights Avenger. You do not need to be near your ally when they fall.

rules.name: Light in the Dark
rules.description: At the end of this character's Activation, Recover 3 a troop within 2. You may remove a Bane from the troop. Limit once per group activation.

rules.name: Opportunist
rules.description:
While attacking outside its activation, Tiger Knight gains Advantage. 

Note: This is essentially when you are commanded to activate when you are outside its activation turn.

rules.name: The Best Defence
rules.description:
When an enemy enters Tiger Knight's threat range, discard a Guard Token to Attack that enemy. 

Note: This is a great combo move to use with Opportunist as it will give you Advantage 1.
